items.a: You want an ad that stands out without spending time on it: Pro ({tiers.pro.priceTier}), the most complete for the price. For a big launch or a demanding brand: Studio ({tiers.studio.priceTier}). Small budget: Essential ({priceCreation}). And if you want to learn to do it yourself: I guide you ({price}).

items.q: What’s the difference between the three options?
items.a: The number of videos and the level of detail. Essential: {tiers.essentielle.videos}, polished, about {tiers.essentielle.videoSeconds} s, delivered within {tiers.essentielle.deliveryHours} hours. Pro: {tiers.pro.videos}, custom-made, 20 to {tiers.pro.videoSeconds} s, with voice-over, vertical and square formats, {tiers.pro.revisionsIncluded}, or a web page instead. Studio: {tiers.studio.videos} up to {tiers.studio.videoSeconds} s in advanced 3D, every format, {tiers.studio.revisionsIncluded}, or a 3D website instead. The “Compare the three options” table has every detail.
You do. Once paid and delivered, you can use, publish and edit it freely, including in ads. I don’t reuse it without your consent.

items.q: I’m a complete beginner. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. With a creation, there’s nothing to know: you describe, I build. With “I guide you”, I adapt my explanations to your level.

Yes, with the Pro and Studio options: choose “Website” when you order. Pro: a custom animated page, made for phones. Studio: a scrolling website with 3D effects, in several sections. I put it online; a domain name (about €10 a year), if you want one, is on you. Essential is for videos only. For an online shop or a multi-page website, email me at {contact}: I’ll reply with a quote.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: If you order as a private individual, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal, under the conditions set out in the terms of sale. By ordering, you ask me to start right away, and you lose this right once my answer or your creation has been fully delivered. Orders placed for business purposes follow the terms for professional clients.
Yes. Payment is handled by Stripe. I never see your card details.
